answer: A bonded registration makes every identity carry a locked, refundable stake that is slashed if the account is a proven duplicate persona. A Sybil farm must fund each puppet up front, so a nebula of fake agents becomes a real cluster of idle capital tied to one wallet. New identities also start in a quarantine haven where peer attestations are required before they can reach the wider network, and that basalt layer of countersigned history is costly to bootstrap for a circular ring of fresh accounts. The attacker pays the deposit plus the burned stake on each detection.
